final: WITH per_site AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zone, s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CASE WHEN p.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND p.procgpu IS NOT NULL AND p.proccpu <> 0 THEN CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / p.proccpu END) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_mem, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat
